info.name: Oracle GoldenGate for Big Data REST Artifacts Groups API

description.content:
REST API for managing Oracle GoldenGate for Big Data deployments via the Microservices Architecture. Enables configuration and monitoring of replication to big data targets including Apache Kafka, HDFS, HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and cloud object stores. Uses the same Microservices Architecture REST API base as the core GoldenGate product with big data-specific replicat handlers and data target types.
